name: explorer-nesting-colors
description: Colors Explorer indent guides by nesting depth and thickens the active folder's guide. Labels keep your theme's colors.

enumDescriptions: Shades of the default VS Code accent blue.

explorerNesting.palette.markdownDescription: Guide colors by depth. A preset name (with dark and light variants), or an array of hex colors used for every theme. Depth `i` uses `palette[i % length]`.

enumDescriptions: Tint each indent column with its depth color.
Also tint each row with its parent folder's color, so every folder's contents read as a colored block.
explorerNesting.sectionBackgrounds.description: Tint the background of each nesting section. Labels keep their theme colors.

explorerNesting.sectionOpacity.description: Section tint strength in percent. The active folder's section uses double.

explorerNesting.guideWidth.description: Width in pixels of indent guides.

explorerNesting.activeGuideWidth.description: Width in pixels of the guide spanning the active folder's subtree.

explorerNesting.indent.markdownDescription: Tree indent in pixels. Written through to `#workbench.tree.indent#`.

explorerNesting.tintFolderIcons.description: Tint folder twisties and font-based folder icons with their depth color. Labels are never recolored.

explorerNesting.dimInactiveGuides.description: Drop non-active guides to 40% opacity (instead of 85%).

explorerNesting.fixChecksums.markdownDescription: Also update the `workbench.html` checksum in VS Code's `product.json` so the "installation appears to be corrupt" warning doesn't appear. Restored on disable.
